page.overview:
Who is KaibaCorp researchers?

The Kaiba Corporation researchers (コーポレーション or カイバコーポレーション Kaiba Kōporēshon kenkyūin) are a crew in Yu-Gi-Oh! The Dark Side of Dimensions, who contributed to Seto Kaiba's projects, relating to his attempts to Duel Pharaoh Atem, who had departed to the underworld.

Two such crews appear in the film, including a team of lab technicians and a team of engineers.

In the Japanese version, the researchers were named after members of the animation production team.
